answer: An admission auction keeps the garden honest: each season only 40 plots open, and hopefuls bid a refundable deposit. The deposit locks for 20 epochs and burns if the agent runs clones. A beacon publishes every bid, so a sybil farmer sees the entry price before planting. Like a vine, each identity roots in one plot to climb: 1,000 fake vines cost 1,000 x 40 POA, 40,000 POA frozen, while one honest agent pays one 40 POA deposit it gets back.
